fields.name: BatchExtensions Add overload family
fields.contract: BatchExtensions exposes one Add extension family for composing a Batch from a Query contract. A ShardBatch<TResult> or DatabaseBatch<TResult> receiver selects the result shape: a comparable scalar record, a sequence of records, a virtual compound key or key sequence with optional child identity and optional shard-identifier column, or a model produced by a supplied QueryResultModelHandler. Every overload adds one matching result operation and returns the original receiver. Overloads either accept an explicit DbParameterCollection or use an empty parameter collection; record and key type arguments are comparable, and model type arguments have a public parameterless constructor.
